## What

The carrier schematic, reusing KV260 carrier blocks:

- SOM connectors
- power tree and the SOM power handshake
- boot-mode straps
- USB 3.0: reference clock, USB 2.0 pair, port power, ESD
- storage
- MCU and watchdog
- OBC interface
- JTAG/UART
- test points

## Done when

- [ ] Schematic review passed, using the B2.3 bench results.
- [ ] ERC clean in CI: restore the `kicad-ci` triggers (see INF-01) against the
      new schematic.
- [ ] BOM priced and long-lead parts ordered.

## Notes

Replaces `H-01` (no connectivity in `hardware/devboard.kicad_sch`). That
schematic was for the ECP5 board and is not carried forward.
